'''''Dominance''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
At some point it was attacked in a deep space star system by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Despite its immense firepower and protective [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]s, Rogue Squadron managed to destroy the vessel.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' {{1st}} {{C|Simulator appearance only}}
